name: Julien
source:
Hard-working, cheerful, and firmly optimistic, Julien is more than your average butler. He serves the wealthy Gaultier family as best he can... which is quite well, when he's not accidentally oversleeping.

Julien was born and raised in the village of Saint-Vailleurs, Mordred's picturesque setting. Once, he scrabbled together a living through odd jobs in town; then he received a welcome–though mysteriously sudden–offer to serve as the Gaultier manor's butler.

[From the [url=https://mordred-f.jimdo.com/]official site[/url]]
